{{Quote|There are only ''three'' of these deadly droids known to exist in the whole universe&mdash;it's a ''collectors' item''... and nedless to say, ''completely unstoppable''!|[[Kenna]], to [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]]|<ref name="The Collector" />}}
The '''executioner droid''' was a very rare [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] model. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], there was only three of these deadly [[Droid/Legends|droids]] known to exist in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. One executioner droid, owned by the [[Collector/Legends|collector]] [[Kenna]], faced [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] aboard [[Kenna's starship]] when the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] went on a [[Mission to an abandoned planetoid|mission]] to an [[abandoned planetoid]].
